prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Monday October 5, 2026. Topic: Company news: biotech, pharma and medical-device.

Window: Friday October 2, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET) through Monday October 5, 2026 12:20 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. This spans 2 non-trading day(s): news published on those days (e.g. Saturday and Sunday) is in scope and often the most important. Anything published after 12:20 ET on Monday October 5, 2026 is out of scope.

FIND
Every material company-specific news item for US-listed biotech, pharma and medical-device companies >= $1B in the window, as many as you can find: press releases, 8-K filings, executive changes, activist campaigns, legal settlements, contracts, product launches, guidance, analyst rating/PT changes (firm, old → new), and the stock move. One bullet per company.

Run multiple searches with different phrasings and dates. Prefer primary sources and wire services
(Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, CNBC, WSJ, MarketWatch, Barron's, Investopedia, company press releases, SEC
EDGAR, BLS/BEA/Census/Fed releases, FDA). For every item give the latest status as of the cutoff.

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or topic:

## TICKER or Topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics / Crypto / Calendar /
Pharma / Energy / Retail, or a concise sector name. Bold tickers.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.
content:
## **NVS** — Pharma

- Novartis agreed to license Abogen Biosciences’ experimental mRNA-encoded T-cell engager **ABO2203**, paying **$575 million upfront** and potentially up to **$7.2 billion** in milestone and option payments, for a total deal value of up to **$7.8 billion**. (Morningstar/Dow Jones, Oct. 2, 21:06 ET; The Bench Bio, Oct. 3, 21:10 ET)

## **SMMT** — Biotech

- Summit Therapeutics announced a clinical-trial collaboration with Daiichi Sankyo and AstraZeneca to evaluate **ivonescimab** with **datopotamab deruxtecan (Datroway)** across multiple solid-tumor settings, including breast and lung cancer. (Investrade, Oct. 2, 16:34 ET)

## **AZN** — Pharma

- AstraZeneca entered a clinical-trial collaboration with Summit Therapeutics and Daiichi Sankyo to study **ivonescimab plus Datroway** in multiple solid tumors, including breast and lung cancer. (Investrade, Oct. 2, 16:34 ET)

## **IART** — Medical Devices

- Integra LifeSciences issued preliminary third-quarter 2026 results of **$410 million–$412 million revenue** and **$0.55–$0.59 adjusted EPS**, and cut full-year 2026 guidance to **$1.634 billion–$1.654 billion revenue** from **$1.654 billion–$1.695 billion**, and **$2.30–$2.40 adjusted EPS** from **$2.40–$2.50**, citing flooding at its Cincinnati facility. (Investrade, Oct. 2, 16:34 ET; StockTitan, Oct. 2, time not reported)

## **ABT** — Medical Devices / Pharma

- Redburn upgraded Abbott Laboratories to **Buy from Neutral** and raised its price target to **$127 from $119**. (247WallSt, Oct. 2, time not reported)

## **SRZN** — Biotech

- Surrozen announced FDA clearance of the **SZN-8141 investigational new drug application** for diabetic macular edema; the company said it expects to dose the first patient in a Phase 1b/2a **DUET** study in **Q4 2026**, with the clearance triggering a milestone toward a second closing expected around **October 20, 2026**, for approximately **$95.1 million** in gross proceeds. (StockTitan, Oct. 2, time not reported)

## **PYXS** — Biotech

- Pyxis Oncology closed a public offering that generated approximately **$110.0 million** in upfront gross proceeds from common shares and pre-funded warrants; full cash exercise of accompanying warrants could raise total gross proceeds to approximately **$282.6 million**. (StockTitan, Oct. 2, time not reported)

## **RARE** — Biotech

- Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical submitted a marketing-authorisation application to the European Medicines Agency for its investigational gene therapy for **mucopolysaccharidosis type IIIA (Sanfilippo syndrome type A)**. (StockTitan, Oct. 2, time not reported)

## **MDT** — Medical Devices

- Edwards Lifesciences’ **AUTUS Size-Adjustable Valve** received FDA premarket approval on **October 1, 2026**; the pediatric pulmonary valve can be implanted at approximately **13 millimeters** and expanded with a balloon catheter to **22 millimeters**. (Nova Pharma News, Oct. 4, time not reported)

## **NXLI** — Medical Devices

- Nexalin Technology agreed to a **10-year** distribution and manufacturing deal with Inovanexa Medical Technologies for its **Nexalin Sync** neurostimulation device; the device was approved for distribution in **seven South American countries**. Shares were down **more than 18% premarket** and down **26% intraday** on October 2. (CNBC, Oct. 2, premarket and midday reports; publication times not reported)

## **MRNA** — Biotech

- Moderna was scheduled to become a component of the **Nasdaq-100 before the October 9, 2026 market open**. (Investrade, Oct. 2, 16:34 ET)

## Genmab — Biotech

- Genmab reported that investigational folate-receptor-alpha antibody-drug conjugate **rinatabart sesutecan** produced a confirmed objective response rate of **45.9% among 109 treated patients** in Part C of the Phase 1/2 **RAINFOL-01** trial, including **five complete responses**. Genmab is not a US-listed company, so no US-listed ticker was identified in the available results. (Swil-News, Oct. 4, time not reported)
